name: Telvoikai
source:
You've been tasked with collecting data on an alien planet. Choose between exploring the jungle tropics or navigating deep into the bioluminescent sea.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2652740/Telvoikai/]Steam[/url]]

你的任务是收集外星球上的数据。你可以选择探索热带丛林或深入生物发光海洋。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2652740/Telvoikai/]Steam[/url]]
